sections.Profile:
"World Challenge Soccer" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1994. It features a soccer theme with three flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode. Part of the Gottlieb System 3 series, the game was designed by Jon Norris with artwork by Constantino Mitchell, David Moore, and Jeanine Mitchell. A total of 1,470 units were produced.
